items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: It was he and I and Arthur Schutt and Jimmy Dorsey playing clarinet

ctx.x: He used to talk about a lot, and how much he admired him.

Yes, Adrian did a date under the name of the California Ramblers, and I think -- was it that one, or -- no, it was one of those Brunswick dates, and that I did with him. That's right, I worked with him. It was one of those groups. It was he and I and Arthur Schutt and Jimmy Dorsey playing clarinet and if I'm not mistaken, Manny Klein. You'd just go in and play the popular tunes of the day, and -- and then I used him on vibraphones on one date that I did for the Irving Mills thing. I think that was a California…
